notes.title: New Content: Traps, yelps, and finances!
notes.content:
[h1]Traps, Yelps, and Finances Update[/h1]
Hello everyone!  Happy to announce a new content update is now available for Dungeon Overseer.  In this update we focused on adding new requested content and making some adjustments to balance.  We appreciate everyone who has played Dungeon Overseer so far and look forward to hearing how you are enjoying the new content and changes.

[h2]New Feature: Traps[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40883573/d107b6e88f115da1bf8ea3eec5e62a0a585a431e.png[/img]
Traps have been added to Dungeon Overseer!  There are 5 different traps each costing a different single rare resource to create.  They can be placed prior to combat or during combat with a small delay before activation(this makes it so you can also use them like spells during combat).  There are a variety of effects, single trigger damage, triple trigger damage, damage all enemies, and snare enemy.  

[h2]New Feature: Minion Smacking[/h2]
Minion smacking has been added and while it doesn't effect gameplay it is amusing.  Clicking on any minion or goblin will now result in a "smack" which will make them yelp or groan.  Excessive smacking can result in the occasional laugh or jibe from the overlord(he takes pleasure in your minions suffering).

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
After reading the forums and communicating with players we have made a series of changes to balance and gameplay that will result in a smoother and more entertaining experience.

[b]The Forge[/b]
Crafting times have been adjusted on all ingot tiers.  This is to address lower tier ingots accessibility.
[olist]
[*]Copper Ingots now 3 seconds to craft
[*]Blackiron Ingots now 6 seconds to craft
[*]Ethereum Ingots now 9 seconds to craft
[*]Demonic Ingots now 12 seconds to craft
[*]Soulsteel Ingots now 15 seconds to craft
[/olist]

[b]The Raids[/b]
Raiding rewards were lackluster in the early game balance.  To improve this and to improve the accessibility of lower tier ingots, rare rewards have been increased.  Previously a raiding minion finding a rare reward would result in 2 rare ingots of their corresponding tier.  Now based on the "tier" of the minion raiding rare rewards are as follows.

[olist]
[*]Goblin Berserker will now find 5 Copper Ingots each time it discovers a rare opportunity
[*]Fallen Knights will now find 4 Blackiron Ingots each time it discovers a rare opportunity
[*]Flame Lords will now find 3 Ethereum Ingots each time it discovers a rare opportunity
[*]Lich Kings will now find 2 Demonic Ingots each time it discovers a rare opportunity
[*]Dark Lords will now find 2 Soulsteel Ingots each time it discovers a rare opportunity
[/olist]

[b]Other Changes[/b]
Continuing to improve balance and squash bugs, we have added and changed the following:

[olist]
[*]The trader now will purchase your unused research points in quantities of 500
[*]Research speed has been slightly reduced
[*]Minor menu glitches have been fixed
[*]Added new sound effects to goblins
[*]Minor adjustments to golem run speeds
[/olist]

We look forward to hearing from the community on these new additions!  Thank you for your feedback and ideas, have fun!

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: Quick fix for a specific bug relating to invasions.  Prior if you lost an invasion in combination with several other factors your minions would "lose all hope" and stand not defending till their untimely demise.  This has been fixed and they will now defend with all of their minion might.

notes.title: Dungeon Overseer Update
notes.content:
Hello Overseers!

After gathering some feedback a new update has been released.  

This update includes a new hardcore mode which can be toggled in the settings in-game menu.  This can be turned on and off at anytime during gameplay, this is to keep a more casual nature while still allowing players to experience increased invasion frequency and difficulty if they wish.  I would suggest prior to turning it on you at a minimum have a foundry and some spare resources so you can resurrect your fallen minions.

A resolution and quality settings dialogue box has been added.  Prior it would auto detect your default resolution and use that as your game resolution.  This added a level of inconvenience that should be rectified with the new dialogue box.  Suggested resolution is 1920x1080 with ultra settings.

Finally the store page description and tags have been updated.  The RTS tag and mention in description have been removed, while there are certainly still RTS elements the tags and description seemed to be attracting a more action RTS type player while Dungeon Overseer is more of a casual RTS.  The removal of these tags should make it more clear what to expect from Dungeon Overseer along with the in detail store description, trailer, and 10 minute gameplay video also available on the store page.

It has been exciting seeing the Overseer community grow with playtimes ranging from 1-15 hours.  We look forward to hearing back from some of the community who have really delved into the depths of the dungeon overseer experience.  

PS. Heard people wanted traps and the ability to smack minions so it's next on the list to be added!

notes.title: Coming Soon New Dungeon Overseer Content
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Overseers! [/h1] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40883573/41488ca8bd5f1333bd79e9fe7d01f5604f8c68c1.png[/img]

[h2]New Features Coming Soon[/h2]

We have some new features in the works that should be ready for our early access launch.  We will update progress on our Steam community forums and announcements.  Stop by the forums and join the Dungeon Overseer community!

We are currently working on implementing a new save system and edit system so you can rename your minions to whatever you like.  Nothing makes a minion like your own when you can name him Fido!  We look forward to seeing peoples funny and serious creations alike.  

Also on the agenda is a new feature regarding a wandering vendor that will pop into you dungeon occasionally when he feels like a bargain might interest you.  This will help balance your resource pools by being able to make a trade and get rid of some of those excess materials.

[h3]Join us in the Dungeon Overseer community[/h3]
[b]Join our forums and let us know what you think.  We look forward to sharing more exciting news with you soon.   Thank you for your support![/b]

notes.title: We Salute You Overseer
notes.content:
[h1]Dungeon Overseer[/h1]

Dungeon Overseer is entering Early Access soon!  It's been a long journey to get here but we have a fun and exciting game almost ready for the fans.  The Dungeon Overseer forums are up and running for you to pop in a ask any questions you might have.  The forums will help Dungeon Overseer progress through Early Access as we take your ideas and suggestions and turn them into reality.  Hop on over to the forums and join the community.  

The pipeline is packed full of new additional content and we're excited to share an already feature rich experience with you.  We will post further information on upcoming features in content in future announcements and on the forums.  We appreciate your support and Salute You Overseer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40883573/b9146fadfbd4186fce72d879f46cb65d10fa1390.png[/img]

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]

[h3]Build Your Lair[/h3]
Construct your dungeon with a multi tier tile system. All construction is based on your tile layouts so you can shape your dungeon the way you want. Certain minions hang out in certain rooms so designing your layout can assist with defense.

[list]
[*] Design the perfect dungeon layout with the tile foundation system
[*] Construct 10 different unique room types
[*] Upgrade and expand each room type 4 times with special bonuses each tier
[*] Purchase add ons for each room type to further add bonuses and unlock special features
[/list]


[h3]Recruit[/h3]
Recruit from a variety of minions each with a specific benefit and purpose. Level them up and increase not only their power but the rewards they can earn while raiding. Higher tier minions can collect higher tier resources.

[list]
[*] Construct your lair, library, and temple rooms to unlock new minions
[*] Higher tier minions collect rarer resources while raiding
[*] Level up your recruits to increase their power and their raiding results
[/list]


[h3]Quest[/h3]
Detailed quests will help guide you through each part of becoming The Overseer. Continue to advance and unlock new quests that will assist in the construction and recruitment of your minions.

[list]
[*] Learn the ropes while collecting rewards
[*] Complete over 20 initial current quests
[*] The current quest line will have your dungeon up and running in no time
[/list]


[h3]Raid[/h3]
While in base your minions gain experience but the best experience is while they are sent out into the world on raids. Monitor their progress, revive, level up, and order them to return home through the minion raid screen.

[list]
[*] Demand obedience and send minions on raids via the Overseers Roster
[*] Each minion collects experience, resources, and a tier specific rare while raiding
[*] Monitor each minions progress via the Overseers Raid screen and level them up, revive them, and order their return to collect spoils
[/list]


[h3]Defend[/h3]
The elemental golems that protect the mountain haven't taken kindly to your constant construction inside their home. Defend your base from invasions by designing a well laid out base and hiring the proper minions to defend against each incursion.

[list]
[*] While you maybe the Overseer your new mountain home is plagued by Golems who dislike your industrious efforts
[*] Construct a solid base layout to protect your troops from the golems
[*] Hire minions to fight off the golem armies.
[*] Collect rewards for defending or lose resources for failing the challenge is yours
[/list]


[h3]Research[/h3]
Research plays a vital role in the development of your dungeon. Unlock new add ons for each room type, upgrade your minions power, and even unlock the best minion and resource through research.

[list]
[*] Collect research points from your library
[*] Research upgrades for your rooms to unlock add ons
[*] Research upgrades to increase your minions power
[/list]


[h3]Craft[/h3]
You collect base resources throughout your dungeon as minions produce them for you. You can then use the foundry to craft rare ingots from those base resources. These ingots are the foundation for the toughest minions and highest tier room construction.

[list]
[*] Unlock rare resource crafting in the foundry room
[*] Upgrade your foundry to increase the rate at which rares are produced
[*] Upgrade your foundry to unlock higher tier rare resources needed for your base and minions
[/list]
